limitations: Reference intervals are screening aids for research datasets, not clinical decision support.
A value outside a reference interval may be abnormal but clinically plausible; it is not automatically invalid.
Passing configured numerical ranges does not establish clinical validity, safety or fitness for patient care.
Relationship rules are applied only when the required measurements and context are present.
Operational plausible limits are configurable data-quality bounds, not medical reference limits.
clinicalValidation.method: Not applied to the Standard generation profile

bmiConsistency.correction: Derived BMI recalculated from final validated height and weight when inconsistent or missing.

notes: Approved columns are the demographic, disease and clinical measurements selected for this job.
Generated output must contain only approved medical columns and no identifiers/PII.
Content scanning covers email, phone and long identifier-like tokens in the final output only.
